report.title: Audit an existing report's citations for resolvability and actual support
report.question_or_target: For a completed research artifact, what fraction of its citations (a) resolve at all, (b) resolve to content that still contains the cited assertion, and (c) actually SUPPORT the sentence they are attached to rather than merely being topically adjacent - measured over every citation in one real artifact, not a sample?

target_artifact.selection_basis: A finished grounding report with sections 1-6 marked measured and executed and exactly three inline external citations in its external-SOTA section.

population.definition: Every inline external Markdown link in the selected artifact.

report.adjudication_rule: A citation SUPPORTS only when the quoted source span substantiates every material model, quantity, relation, and qualifier in the attached sentence. Topic overlap or support for only a generic subclaim is NON-SUPPORTING.
